name: Luxury Small Box Bag
description:
Design: Solid FLAP,The solid flap design adds a touch of elegance to this mini dionysus gucci bag, making it a stylish accessory.
Closure Type: Zipper,Secure your belongings with a smooth zipper closure, ensuring your items stay safe and organized.
Occasion: Versatile,Ideal for various occasions, this small designer bag transitions seamlessly from day to night.
Material: Nylon,Crafted from durable nylon, this small designer bag offers lasting wear and easy maintenance.
Size: 20*6*12cm,Compact and convenient, the mini purse fits essentials without bulk, perfect for concerts or parties.
